theme: Open day, with the trip clock ticking.
greeting: Clear calendar today, Dan — nothing scheduled until tomorrow's NACD New England call at noon. That leaves the whole open day for the Croatia prep stacking up before you fly on the 8th.

needsAttention.title: NACD New England intro call at noon
needsAttention.detail: Larissa Ravetto's chapter call sits on tomorrow's calendar at 12 PM ET, with Ellen Richstone and Deb Rosenthal on it. Arrive with a short read on what you want from the chapter — board-seat pipeline and where you'd contribute.

needsAttention.title: Pack the travel larder bin
needsAttention.detail: The rolling pantry bin is due today, built and packed before Wednesday's House 1 to House 2 move so the first migration is a test run while there's still time to fix it.

needsAttention.title: Two Croatia lodging gaps still open
needsAttention.detail: The Cavtat night of Sept 19 and the St. Pete landing gap of Sept 20-22 are both unbooked P1s. Charter connectivity is poor, so they have to be booked from dry land before you leave on the 8th.

needsAttention.title: Confirm checked bags on the Croatia ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued Basic Economy fare shows zero checked bags. Confirm the allowance on Eurowings Discover's own site and buy bags now if they aren't included, before airport-counter rates apply.

flagged.title: Nautilus Sailing invoice unfinished
flagged.detail: A QuickBooks invoice for the Croatia charter is still marked unpaid — worth closing before the Sept 8 departure.

inbox.noise: Labor Day sales and newsletters filled the rest — West Marine, Whisker, Campo Grande, a St. Pete realtor, a markets digest.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is waiting on your reply.

recipe.title: Green Salad with Green Beans
recipe.why: High summer means beans and tender leaves are at their peak, so keep it fresh and barely dressed.

tasks.title: Book refundable backup rental car, Sept 20-Oct 5
Buy EU plug adapters and a US power strip

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar this morning — the first commitment isn't until midday tomorrow.
An open afternoon at the Kenwood stay in St. Petersburg, room to clear the trip backlog.
The day ends unhurried, the girls in residence and no evening plans on the books.
